import sys

def modArr(arr):
    output = []

    for i in range(len(arr)):
        ptr1, ptr2 = i, (i+1 if arr[i] % 2 == 0 else i-1)
        output.append(arr[j] for j in range(ptr1, ptr2))

    return output
